column1: New Zealand is a small country of four million inhabitants, a long-haul flight from all the major tourist-generating markets of the world.
column2: 新西兰是一个有400万居民的小国，从全球任何一个主要客源地去那里，都得乘坐长途航班。

column1: Tourism currently makes up 9% of the country’s gross domestic product, and is the country’s largest export sector.
column2: 目前，旅游业占新西兰国内生产总值的9%，也是该国最大的出口部门。
column6: gross domestic product|国内生产总值

column1: Unlike other export sectors, which make products and then sell them overseas, tourism brings its customers to New Zealand.
column2: 其他出口行业生产商品后销往海外，旅游业则把顾客带到新西兰来。

column1: The product is the country itself — the people, the places and the experiences.
column2: 新西兰这个国家本身就是产品：那里的人、地方以及游客能获得的体验。

column1: In 1999, Tourism New Zealand launched a campaign to communicate a new brand position to the world.
column2: 1999年，新西兰旅游局发起一项推广活动，向世界传达新西兰新的品牌定位。
column3: Tourism New Zealand|新西兰旅游局

column1: The campaign focused on New Zealand’s scenic beauty, exhilarating outdoor activities and authentic Maori culture, and it made New Zealand one of the strongest national brands in the world.
column2: 活动着重展示新西兰的自然美景、令人振奋的户外活动和原汁原味的毛利文化，使新西兰成为世界上最有影响力的国家品牌之一。

column1: A key feature of the campaign was the website www.newzealand.com, which provided potential visitors to New Zealand with a single gateway to everything the destination had to offer.
column2: 这次活动的一大特色是网站www.newzealand.com。打算到新西兰旅游的人可以从这个统一入口了解当地能提供的一切。

column1: The heart of the website was a database of tourism services operators, both those based in New Zealand and those based abroad which offered tourism services to the country.
column2: 网站的核心是一个旅游服务商数据库，其中既有设在新西兰的商家，也有位于海外、提供赴新西兰旅游服务的企业。
column5: tourism services operators|旅游服务经营者

column1: Any tourism-related business could be listed by filling in a simple form.
column2: 任何旅游相关企业只需填写一张简单的表格，就能被列入名录。

column1: This meant that even the smallest bed and breakfast address or specialist activity provider could gain a web presence with access to an audience of long-haul visitors.
column2: 这意味着，哪怕是最小的家庭旅馆，或是专门组织某项活动的商家，也能在网上占有一席之地，接触到远道而来的潜在游客。
column3: bed and breakfast|提供住宿和早餐的家庭旅馆
column4: specialist activity provider|专门组织某类活动的商家
column5: web presence|在网上的展示渠道

column1: In addition, because participating businesses were able to update the details they gave on a regular basis, the information provided remained accurate.
column2: 此外，参与的企业能够定期更新自己提交的资料，因此网站提供的信息始终准确。

column1: And to maintain and improve standards, Tourism New Zealand organised a scheme whereby organisations appearing on the website underwent an independent evaluation against a set of agreed national standards of quality.
column2: 为了维持并提高服务标准，新西兰旅游局还推行了一项计划，要求网站上收录的机构依据一套公认的全国质量标准接受独立评估。
column8: agreed national standards of quality|公认的全国质量标准

column1: As part of this, the effect of each business on the environment was considered.
column2: 各家企业对环境的影响，也列入了评估范围。
column3: As part of this|作为这项评估的一部分

column1: To communicate the New Zealand experience, the site also carried features relating to famous people and places.
column2: 为展示在新西兰旅行的体验，网站还刊登了与当地名人和名胜有关的专题。
column7: famous people and places|名人与名胜

column1: One of the most popular was an interview with former New Zealand All Blacks rugby captain Tana Umaga.
column2: 最受欢迎的专题之一，是对新西兰“全黑队”前橄榄球队长塔纳·乌马加的采访。

column1: Another feature that attracted a lot of attention was an interactive journey through a number of the locations chosen for blockbuster films which had made use of New Zealand’s stunning scenery as a backdrop.
column2: 另一项备受瞩目的专题是一趟互动之旅，带游客探访许多取景地。不少大片选中了这些地方，以新西兰的壮丽景色为背景。
column3: attracted a lot of attention|受到广泛关注

column1: As the site developed, additional features were added to help independent travellers devise their own customised itineraries.
column2: 随着网站的发展，又增添了一些功能，帮助自助游客规划量身定制的行程。

column1: To make it easier to plan motoring holidays, the site catalogued the most popular driving routes in the country, highlighting different routes according to the season and indicating distances and times.
column2: 为了方便游客规划自驾游，网站把全国最受欢迎的自驾路线编成目录，按季节重点推荐不同路线，并标出路程和行车时间。
column7: according to the season|根据季节
column8: distances and times|路程和行车时间

column1: Later, a Travel Planner feature was added, which allowed visitors to click and ‘bookmark’ places or attractions they were interested in, and then view the results on a map.
column2: 后来，网站又推出“行程规划器”。游客可以点击自己感兴趣的地点或景点并添加“书签”，再到地图上查看所选结果。

column1: The Travel Planner offered suggested routes and public transport options between the chosen locations.
column2: 行程规划器会推荐所选地点之间的线路，以及可以乘坐哪些公共交通工具。
column4: public transport options|可选的公共交通工具

column1: There were also links to accommodation in the area.
column2: 它还提供通往当地住宿信息的链接。

column1: By registering with the website, users could save their Travel Plan and return to it later, or print it out to take on the visit.
column2: 用户在网站注册后，可以保存自己的出行计划，留待日后查看，也可以把计划打印出来带着旅行。
column6: return to it later|日后再查看
column7: print it out|把它打印出来

column1: The website also had a ‘Your Words’ section where anyone could submit a blog of their New Zealand travels for possible inclusion on the website.
column2: 网站还设有“说说你的故事”栏目，任何人都可以提交记录自己新西兰之旅的博客文章，有机会获网站选登。

column1: The Tourism New Zealand website won two Webby awards for online achievement and innovation.
column2: 新西兰旅游局网站因其在网络领域的成就与创新，获得了两项威比奖。

column1: More importantly perhaps, the growth of tourism to New Zealand was impressive.
column2: 或许更为重要的是，新西兰入境旅游业的增长相当亮眼。

column1: Overall tourism expenditure increased by an average of 6.9% per year between 1999 and 2004.
column2: 1999年至2004年，旅游总支出平均每年增长6.9%。

column1: From Britain, visits to New Zealand grew at an average annual rate of 13% between 2002 and 2006, compared to a rate of 4% overall for British visits abroad.
column2: 2002年至2006年，英国游客赴新西兰的访问量年均增长13%；同期英国人出国旅游的总访问量年均仅增长4%。
column3: visits to New Zealand|赴新西兰访问人次

column1: The website was set up to allow both individuals and travel organisations to create itineraries and travel packages to suit their own needs and interests.
column2: 网站建立的目的是使个人和旅游机构都能按照各自的需要和兴趣，设计行程和旅游套餐。

column1: On the website, visitors can search for activities not solely by geographical location, but also by the particular nature of the activity.
column2: 游客在网上寻找活动时，除了能按地理位置查找，也能按活动本身的具体性质筛选。

column1: This is important as research shows that activities are the key driver of visitor satisfaction, contributing 74% to visitor satisfaction, while transport and accommodation account for the remaining 26%.
column2: 这一点很重要，因为研究显示，活动体验是决定游客满意度的首要因素，它对满意度的贡献占74%，交通和住宿合计占其余26%。

column1: The more activities that visitors undertake, the more satisfied they will be.
column2: 游客参加的活动越多，满意度就越高。

column1: It has also been found that visitors enjoy cultural activities most when they are interactive, such as visiting a marae (meeting ground) to learn about traditional Maori life.
column2: 研究还发现，游客最喜欢能亲身参与的文化活动，比如去毛利人的聚会场所了解传统的毛利生活。
column5: marae|n. 毛利人的聚会场所
column7: traditional Maori life|毛利人的传统生活

column1: Many long-haul travellers enjoy such learning experiences, which provide them with stories to take home to their friends and family.
column2: 许多长途游客喜欢这样的学习体验，旅途中的见闻也成了他们回家之后讲给亲友听的故事。

column1: In addition, it appears that visitors to New Zealand don’t want to be ‘one of the crowd’ and find activities that involve only a few people more special and meaningful.
column2: 此外，到新西兰旅游的人似乎不愿只是“人群中的一员”，往往觉得只有少数人参与的活动更特别、更有意义。
column4: one of the crowd|人群中的普通一员
column6: only a few people|只有少数人

column1: It could be argued that New Zealand is not a typical destination.
column2: 有人或许会认为，新西兰并不是一个典型的旅游目的地。
column3: could be argued|或许可以认为

column1: New Zealand is a small country with a visitor economy composed mainly of small businesses.
column2: 新西兰是个小国，旅游经济的主体是小企业。

column1: It is generally perceived as a safe English-speaking country with a reliable transport infrastructure.
column2: 人们普遍认为，新西兰是一个安全的英语国家，并且拥有可靠的交通基础设施。

column1: Because of the long-haul flight, most visitors stay for longer (average 20 days) and want to see as much of the country as possible on what is often seen as a once-in-a-lifetime visit.
column2: 由于航程遥远，大多数游客会在新西兰停留较长时间，平均为20天。他们往往把这看成一生难得一次的旅行，因此希望尽可能多走一些地方。
column6: as much of the country as possible|尽可能多地看这个国家
column7: once-in-a-lifetime visit|一生难得一次的旅行

column1: However, the underlying lessons apply anywhere — the effectiveness of a strong brand, a strategy based on unique experiences and a comprehensive and user-friendly website.
column2: 不过，从中得到的经验适用于任何地方：强有力的品牌、以独特体验为核心的策略，以及内容全面、便于使用的网站，都能发挥作用。
